title: McDonalds Aggregator
tagline: A job portal that uses encrypted salary data to match candidates with employers.

prizes.placement: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer
prizes.title: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer

description: A job portal which allows companies to post jobs with encrypted salaries, and applicants to share encrypted salary expectation using FHE. Each of them can get matched with the respective candidate or job without knowing the salary range of the other. For jobs you can't edit the range and for candidates you can only do it after 3 months.
how_its_made: We've used Dynamic, Blockscout for an improved UI / UX and Inco for storing encrypted data (job salary information). The UI has been developed with the Vite framework and the Smart contracts deployed with Remix and Hardhat. We've used Inco "getting started" guides to help us starting developing with FHE. We used Worldcoin for identity and login.
